code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    border = Counter(
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h)
        for c in range(w)
        if (r in (0, h-1) or c in (0, w-1)) and grid[r][c] != 0
    ).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = Counter(
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(1, h-1)
        for c in range(1, w-1)
        if grid[r][c] not in (0, border)
    )
    fill = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best_color, best_density = fill, 0
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(1,h-1) for c in range(1,w-1) if grid[r][c] == color]
        rs, cs = [r for r,c in cells], [c for r,c in cells]
        density = len(cells) / ((max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*(max(cs)-min(cs)+1))
        if density > best_density:
            best_color, best_density = color, density
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(1,h-1) for c in range(1,w-1) if grid[r][c] == best_color]
    rs, cs = [r for r,c in cells], [c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return [
        [border if r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1)
         else best_color if r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1 else fill
         for c in range(w)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]
'''
